messages:
anika: heads-up: we're scheduling the 'add-prefetch-index + staged backfill' during the 30m change window at 14:40 UTC. initial canary 1% traffic, then ramp if stable.
mike: can you confirm exclusive-lock duration for the swap op? last time it spiked to ~3m.
anika: swap is implemented as a rename pattern: create new index, backfill, then rename tables in a single transaction. expect 60-120s exclusive on primary. we've added quiesce steps.
deploybot: preflight checks passed (lint, migration-plan). holdpoint scheduled at 5001100030 (initiator: anika).
ops-bot: runbook linked: https://runbooks.internal/migrations/prefetch-index. monitors: db_lock_rate, read_p99, replica_lag, backfill_rows_per_min. alerts configured.
dbadmin: safe-drop helper prepared; it verifies pg_stat_activity and open transactions before dropping. will only allow drop when safe.
mike: rollback path? paste commands.
anika: rollback quick commands below:
```
# stop backfill
kubectl -n prod scale deployment prefetch-backfill --replicas=0
# disable feature flag
curl -X POST https://flags.internal/migrations -d '{"prefetch_index":false}'
# run safe-drop if partially created
./safe_drop_index --index prefetch_idx --confirm
```
tara: who has permission to flip the feature flag in emergency? ops oncall (dbadmin) + release lead (anika).
deploybot: canary started at 5001100035 30 routing=1%
dbadmin: watching replica lag and lock counters. current backfill rate ~9k rows/min on canary. no locks.
anika: gating to 20% requires: p99 within +15% baseline for 10m, backfill progress >50% on canary, db_lock_rate <0.2%.
mike: add an automated escape: if read_p99 > 220ms for 3m, auto-release holdpoint and abort. who implements?
anika: runbook automation will post and ops oncall will be paged; DB admin can trigger auto-abort script.
deploybot: holdpoint released at 5001100058 by anika. proceeding to 20% ramp.
tara: I'll update release notes: mention pinned launcher, feature-flag gating, expected swap window, rollback commands, and runbook link.
